messages:
laura: Heads-up: small maintenance in az3 to adjust fan-curve + 5% powercap reduction on 20 racks to address thermal headroom alerts. Window: Sun 2026-04-26 02:00-03:30 UTC. Expect soft drains and sub-2min host perturbations per rack.

ben: Which pools are affected? Dedicated/reserved racks?

laura: Target: az3-edge-burst & az3-spot-slice. Dedicated/reserved excluded; we'll route burst to az1 if spillover.

marta: Past runs caused KV cold starts and p99 blips. Mitigation?

igor: Plan: pre-seed KV on warm standbys at T-35m (seed=0.8), enable prefix warmup, and keep continuous-batching fallback for 1h post-change. Also cap autoscaler maxSurge to 12% (do NOT suspend).

ops-bot: maintenance ticket MO-2699 created: https://redwood.atlassian/issue/MO-2699

ben: Canary: 3 racks in eu-west3 at T-25m. Abort if p99 latency delta > 0.4% or requeue_rate > 0.7%.

marta: Timeline:
- 01:25 pre-seed KV on warm standbys
- 01:35 start eu-west3 canary (3 racks)
- 01:55 validate + 10m buffer
- 02:05 begin az3 staggered cohorts (4 racks / 8min cohort)
- 03:15 final validation
- 03:30 close window

laura: Preflight commands:
```bash
python infra/kvseed.py --pool az3-edge-burst --seed 0.8 --timeout 2400
kubectl patch hpa cluster-autoscaler -p '{"spec":{"maxSurge":0.12}}'
infra/hwctl set-fancurve --racks az3-rack-[01..20] --profile aggressive-1
infra/hwctl set-powercap --racks az3-rack-[01..20] --percent 95
```

ben: Finance quick ballpark: if 45k tokens shift to hosted at $0.0115/token ~= $518. Posting to #finance.

marta: Rollback short playbook: if p99_increase > 0.4% or requeue_rate > 0.7% or thermal-errors increase -> pause rollout, revert last cohort fancurve/powercap, re-inject nodes, route traffic to az1, escalate.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: MO-2699 will run Sun 2026-04-26 02:00 UTC. Canary automation set for T-25m.

laura: Ill publish customer advisory targeted to burst pool owners and lock the autoscaler cap at T-20m. Anything else?

marta: Add suppression tag for synthetic evals during window to avoid noisy alerts. Otherwise good. :thumbsup:
